title: My AI-built ARPG has a bot fleet that soak-tests every build, but it can't tell me if it's fun. Looking for human testers before the Steam demo
author: Defc0ns
selftext:
I'm building Dreadmark, a top-down gothic ARPG, with an AI coding agent writing the implementation while I direct the design and make every call. The free Steam demo goes up on 19 October for Next Fest.

What makes the process workable is a bot fleet. Nine bot instances play each release build for an hour or more before it goes to Steam. They catch exceptions, stuck pathing and saves that no longer load after a version bump, which are the things that break a build. They are good at "did this break" and useless at "did this feel good".

So I need help for the pre-demo build. You need Windows and Steam, I'll DM you a Steam key, and there is a Feedback button in the game that sends me a report with a screenshot. It's early, so expect rough edges and balance that is still moving.

I have about 15 keys. Comment or DM me if you'd like one. Happy to talk about the process too, including where the agent goes wrong.

[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=icPA1bcQ6KY](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=icPA1bcQ6KY)  
[https://dreadmark.agentas.net/](https://dreadmark.agentas.net/)

comments.author: First_Act3728
comments.body:
I think you need to ask yourself - why would I put this on Steam? This doesn't even look like a half-step above greyboxing. 

There's no art, no assets, the whole copy on the site is written by AI and it doesn't look like you bothered changing a single word. Your own reddit post was written by AI. Even the youtube video title is AI generated lol. How does it have 40k views and no comments? Botted?

You shouldn't have to ask others if your game is fun. If you built it at all you would know. I think you seriously need to ask yourself who would bother playing this over any other game. PoE2 is an arpg with "weight" and comes out f2p in 2 months and is infinitely better than this, just based on the video. If your low-poly style is the selling point, what does your game have over an already released and polished game like Polygon Fantasy?

Honestly this looks like a shitty tech demo rather than a game. I'm not trying to be a dick, I just think you need like 6 months more work and some actual person touches before you bother showing this to anyone.

replies.author: Defc0ns
replies.body:
It's a personal project about how far AI can take a game. I use AI for the building and make the decisions myself such as what goes in, what's fun, how it plays, the sounds and the visual effects.

I do ask others if it's fun, because a developer is always biased about their own game and needs someone else's view.

I'm not trying to compete with PoE and I'm very aware of the quality gap. It releases in early access and I'll keep developing it as AI models improve, and if people end up enjoying it, great.

I am aware of poor quality video, and the typical "AI typed" website and they are both pending reworks.
